correctness.rationale: Eight exact forbidden matchings map bijectively to cube vertices; a checked dual nerve and integral combinatorial Alexander duality reduce homology to the independence complex of Q3, exactly two parity tetrahedra joined by four isolated antipodal edges (a three-circle wedge). This yields H5=Z^3. Complete 1-skeleton and filled boundaries for every missing matching triangle establish simple connectivity; Hurewicz and Whitehead then establish the integral three-S5 homotopy type. Independently, the bundled complete face enumeration, perfect acyclic Morse certificate, and signed group Lefschetz enumeration pass for all 48 group elements. No unproved extension to larger graphs is used.

value.rationale: K_{2,2,2} is the smallest balanced three-partite graph with no singleton parts and supports a natural size-three forbidden-matching complex. The exact homotopy type supplies a directly motivated nonbipartite instance of Linusson–Shareshian–Welker Question 1.16 beyond the complete and complete-bipartite theorems. Determination of the full irreducible B3 symmetry module and disappearance of fixed homology gives structurally useful equivariant information not encoded by its dimension; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice, routine definition, or table recomputation.
